question: What is the deadline for the annual income tax return of an individual taxpayer?
apiAnswer:
### Short Answer
The deadline for the annual income tax return of an individual taxpayer is on or before the fifteenth (15th) day of April of each year, covering income for the preceding taxable year.

### Controlling Authorities
This is established under Section 51(C)(1) of the National Internal Revenue Code (NIRC).

### Interpretation
Section 51(C)(1) of the NIRC specifies that individual taxpayers must file their income tax returns by April 15 each year. This requirement applies to all individuals subject to income tax, ensuring that they report their income from the previous year within the stipulated timeframe.

### Practical Meaning
For individual taxpayers, this means they must prepare and submit their income tax returns by April 15 to avoid penalties and interest for late filing. It is essential for taxpayers to keep track of their income and expenses throughout the year to ensure accurate reporting by the deadline.
